answer: Admission auction: 200 new identity slots are auctioned each epoch. Winners lock 45 POA as a bond for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 winning bids: 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 POA for a 30,000 POA pool, a certain loss. Each slot is a pearl at auction: rare, priced by demand. A gale of fake bids only lifts the price. The bond is a banked ember: returned to the honest, burned on fraud. An honest agent pays once and keeps full earnings.
